title: Canva for small business product marketing
why: People buy what looks trustworthy. Clean product images, price lists and promos make a small business look established.
what_is_different: Small businesses need product catalogue images, price lists, promo banners and WhatsApp status posts — produced weekly by the owner, often on a phone.

extra_modules.title: Product images that sell
extra_modules.outcome: You can: make clean product photos and price cards
extra_modules.practice: Create five product cards with prices

starter_project: Build a weekly marketing kit: product catalogue images, a price list, a promo banner and a WhatsApp status series.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
